stem: Which sentence from the selection supports the idea that elephant herds try to guard themselves from danger?

options.label: A
options.text: But an elephant's huge larynx produces very low sounds. (paragraph 3)

options.label: B
options.text: Some gestures\u2014a twitch of an ear, a wag of the head\u2014are so small that most people wouldn't even notice them. (paragraph 4)

options.label: C
options.text: They think it may help the elephants focus all their attention on the sounds and smells around them. (paragraph 5)

options.label: D
options.text: If you ever wonder what an elephant is paying attention to, don't watch its eyes. (paragraph 6)
